independence_declaration.statement: release-auditor authored no DG4 implementation, test, register row, ADR, repair, delivery decision or finding fix. That includes the round-7/8 records D-133 to D-135 and environment.md limitation 6, which the delivery-orchestrator wrote. qa-verifier appears among the authors only for its pre-freeze acceptance tests (QA-A..D under tests/qa and e2e, which the protocol allows). I audited the frozen candidate directly, in a complete disposable clone ($TMPDIR/c: not shallow, 1117 commits, fsck exit 0) at source 8553323. Inputs: the three round-8 specialist records and qa's sidecar; every DG4 run's meta.json and sandbox.json, including the killed runs; findings.json, stages.json, decisions D-088 to D-135 and environment.md; and the content of the cited evidence. I reproduced pnpm test myself inside the load envelope. My only writes are evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG4/audit/round-8/ and, with the Write tool, this record, my verifications sidecar and the gate record.

checks_run.procedure: Verify the assignment hash. Make a complete git clone (not a worktree) under $TMPDIR and check it. Recompute the candidate with --ref in the repository and in the clone checked out at the source commit. Confirm HEAD descends from the source with no change outside docs/delivery, and compare the manifest and stages.json. Run the previous gates historically and the register rules at DG4.
checks_run.command: sha256sum <assignment>; git clone . $TMPDIR/c; git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository; git fsck --connectivity-only; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG4 --ref 8553323d…; (clone @8553323) node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG4; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --historical --stage DG3 | DG2 | DG1; --register DG4
checks_run.environment: repository HEAD 547ed58 (descendant of 8553323); clone $TMPDIR/c; node v24.21.0; auditor sandbox
checks_run.expected: assignment sha 56e8da83…; a complete clone; sha256:8014e5ce…3804 with 1475 files everywhere; DG3, DG2 and DG1 historical PASS; register PASS
checks_run.actual:
The assignment sha256 56e8da834a92…afac10 matches. The clone is complete: is-shallow false, 1117 commits, fsck exit 0. The dangling objects it lists come from the hard-linked local object store and do not affect connectivity. 8553323 is an ancestor of HEAD 547ed58, and git diff 8553323..HEAD outside docs/delivery is empty.

candidate.mjs gives sha256:8014e5ceffe1f374388ff00e59775458601e0a66be40e5dfe32a10c8cd2d3804 with 1475 files, exit 0, both with --ref 8553323 and in the clone at 8553323. The id also equals:
- the manifest (hash_algorithm mth-candidate-v2, 1475 entries, source_commit 8553323);
- stages.json (state VERIFYING, review_rounds[7] = round 8);
- all three round-8 records.

Validators, each exit 0: 'PASS gate DG3 (historical)', 'PASS gate DG2 (historical)', 'PASS gate DG1 (historical)' and 'PASS register rules at DG4'.

The frozen candidate is sound. But the working tree at HEAD hashes to sha256:6f8c254e…d42e, because D-135 was added after the freeze to docs/delivery/decisions.md, which is a manifest entry. See AUD-R8-12.
